calls.bash: eval "$(mu agent remote-env w1 -w eval --shell)"; mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --command "ssh $MU_SSH_ARGS dev -t 'cd ~/ws/w1 && $MU_REMOTE_ENV \$SHELL -ilc \"pi --approve\"'"
mu task claim rt1 -w eval --for w1 --evidence 'remote on dev'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do rt1; mu is not on this host, print your sha when done'
git fetch "ssh://dev/~/ws/w1" HEAD && git cherry-pick FETCH_HEAD
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi
mu task close rt1 -w eval --evidence 'worker on dev finished; commit cherry-picked into main'

text: rt1 ran on dev, its commit is merged into main and the remote working copy is removed.
